title: ConceptX: A Framework for Latent Concept Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Discovering latent concepts through agglomerative hierarchical clustering of contextualized representations to identify words grouped together based on gender connotation.
Using unsupervised hierarchical clustering of latent representations to discover sensitive concepts, such as grouping words with religious connotations (e.g., Hindu and Muslim names).
Extracting and visualizing word clusters from the final layers of models fine-tuned for hate speech detection to identify groupings of toxic language and racial slurs.
